_notes: Developer Portal listing data per game. title <= 50 chars, short_description <= 150 chars, 1-2 genres. No studio name or logo in any title, description or thumbnail (design requirement 4.2). Pick the closest genre names the portal offers; these are suggestions. tier: A = submit first, B = submit after A passes, hold = see SUBMISSION.txt. Incremental is the shelf name used on the website; on YouTube pick Simulation or Casual, whichever the portal offers.

core-drill.title: Core Drill
core-drill.short_description: Tap to dig, buy drills that dig for you, and watch the heat as the rock gets richer and meaner.

tater-line.title: Tater Line
tater-line.short_description: Run a potato line from field to truck. Find the stage that is holding everything up, then fix it.

comet-garden.title: Comet Garden
comet-garden.short_description: Grow a vine from a window box into orbit on water and light, then reseed it for stardust.

puff-puff-fit.title: Puff Puff Fit
puff-puff-fit.short_description: Inflate a squishy blob to fill the chamber, and release before it kisses a spike. Perfect fills rain confetti.

topple-party.title: Topple Party
topple-party.short_description: Sketch domino runs with your finger, hit GO, and watch the cascade clack its way into every target in slow motion.

slingshot-salvage.title: Slingshot Salvage
slingshot-salvage.short_description: Fling your pod through planetary gravity wells, hoover up space junk, and bank scrap for garage upgrades.

freeze-frame.title: Freeze Frame!
freeze-frame.short_description: Flash-freeze water gaps so waddling critters cross before the ice shatters. Every rescue joins your snow village.

volt-rush.title: Volt Rush
volt-rush.short_description: Slide the rod cart under telegraphed strikes, chain combos to x8, then feed a city that earns while you're away.

kaboom-crane.title: Kaboom Crane
kaboom-crane.short_description: Push the wrecking ball like a playground swing. Perfect-timed taps build monster amplitude, then release and level the block.

buzzcut-buddies.title: Buzzcut Buddies
buzzcut-buddies.short_description: Buzz away mountains of fuzz to reveal the cutie underneath. Mind the mohawk requests and fill your salon.

flip-force.title: Flip Force
flip-force.short_description: Thread a drifting orb through attract and repel fields. Tap to swap poles and every force reverses under you.

ping-pilot.title: Ping Pilot
ping-pilot.short_description: The cave is pitch black and your ping paints it for two seconds, but the anglerfish hunts your pings.

bounce-brigade.title: Bounce Brigade
bounce-brigade.short_description: Citizens leap from a smoking building. Place trampolines to bounce them across rooftops into the net, with style points for flips.

parcel-panic.title: Parcel Panic
parcel-panic.short_description: Colored parcels stream toward forked junctions. One tap routes each one home, and gold ones shatter if rushed.

ghost-crew.title: Ghost Crew
ghost-crew.short_description: Run, then rewind. Your last take replays as a ghost holding the plate while the new you walks through.

sky-bloom.title: Sky Bloom
sky-bloom.short_description: Time each tap inside the target ring to fill the night with fireworks. Chain perfects and the whole sky escalates.

fold-friends.title: Fold Friends
fold-friends.short_description: Crisp swipes crease paper into a crane. It blinks, flaps and waddles off to a park that grows with every fold.

bloom-drop.title: Bloom Drop
bloom-drop.short_description: Seeds rattle down a pin field with rising chimes, and wherever they land a flower erupts in your garden for good.

harbor-hustle.title: Harbor Hustle
harbor-hustle.short_description: Six boats, one brain, zero collisions. Thread ferries and darting jet-skis, and near-misses pay a close-call bonus.

beam-team.title: Beam Team
beam-team.short_description: One golden beam snakes through the dark. Rotate mirrors to reroute it live until every lantern blooms into color.

sandfall.title: Sandfall
sandfall.short_description: Real falling-sand physics: route pouring streams into matching jars with shelves you draw, and keep the colors from mixing.

tippy-ship.title: Tippy Ship
tippy-ship.short_description: Drop crates from a swinging crane onto a hull that really floats. Every box makes it sit lower, list further and creak louder.

cut-loose.title: Cut Loose
cut-loose.short_description: Packages hang in webs of taut rope. Cut the right one at the top of the swing and physics delivers it.

return-fire.title: Return Fire
return-fire.short_description: You never fire a shot. Swing your shield to deflect incoming rounds, and the machine army wrecks itself with its own ammo.

broadside-baron.title: Broadside Baron
broadside-baron.short_description: The sea rolls your hull and the roll aims your guns. Fire at the crest of the swell and the whole broadside lands as one.

siege-pile.title: Siege Pile
siege-pile.short_description: Fling ragdoll knights at the castle wall. The ones that fall short heap up into the ramp the next wave climbs.

chopper-drop.title: Chopper Drop
chopper-drop.short_description: Fly the chopper with one finger while the load on your winch swings like a real pendulum. Damp it, or use it to sling cargo.

morphforge.title: Morphforge
morphforge.short_description: Pour essence into an egg and the creature's body grows from your blend. Push the shell to its cracking point for a rare hatch.

weatherwright.title: Weatherwright
weatherwright.short_description: Your creature fights on instinct. Your only move is the weather: call rain onto a spark duel and the whole field turns conductive.

snapcatch.title: Snapcatch
snapcatch.short_description: No throwing, no dice. Frame a creature at the peak of its leap, and the quality of your photo is the catch.

overwind.title: Overwind
overwind.short_description: Wind a real siege engine, watch the frame strain, and let go before it snaps. Shots that fall short pile up into a ramp.

rabble.title: Rabble
rabble.short_description: Load your warband into the catapult one by one. Land inside and they storm the banner; land short and they mill about.

tell.title: Tell
tell.short_description: Every enemy attack shows its element as it winds up. Tap the element that beats it and your creature steps in to block.

handoff.title: Handoff
handoff.short_description: You never touch the fight. You set the order, and each creature that falls hands something to whoever walks in next.

crucible.title: Crucible
crucible.short_description: Feed cores, watch the heat, and bank before the pot cracks. You never lose what you put in, only the value you leave behind.

bonds.title: Bonds
bonds.short_description: Jobs earn levels. Fighting side by side earns bond, and a bonded pair learns a move only the two of them can do.
